Who We Serve

Built for independent retail

We work with the stores that serve their neighborhoods every day — supplying food and general merchandise in the quantities a working store actually needs.

Supermarkets

General-line grocery and merchandise to keep aisles full — from pantry staples to the everyday extras shoppers expect to find in one trip.

Delis

Food, beverages, and disposables that support a busy counter — drinks for the cooler, snacks for the shelf, and the supplies service runs on.

Convenience Stores

Fast-moving snacks, drinks, candy, and general merchandise in store-ready quantities — the lines that keep a small footprint working hard.

How It Works

Ordering, step by step

A straightforward wholesale process — no online checkout, no guesswork. Talk to us, confirm your order, and get your store stocked.

1

Tell us about your store

Use the inquiry form or call us. Share your store type, location, and the products you need.

2

Get pricing & availability

We confirm what is in stock, current case pricing, and pack sizes for the lines on your list.

3

Place your order

Confirm the items and quantities you want. We will go over the order with you before anything is finalized.

4

Arrange fulfillment

We confirm pickup or delivery arrangements for your order and keep you posted on timing.

About Al Kamel

A wholesaler that keeps it simple

Al Kamel General Trading LLC is a general-line grocery merchant wholesaler based in Oceanside, New York. We supply supermarkets, delis, and convenience stores with food and general merchandise — the everyday products stores reorder, from one supplier.

Our focus is practical: a useful assortment, clear pricing, and orders confirmed before they are placed. If you run a store and need a reliable wholesale source, we would like to hear from you.

Mohammed Al Kamel is the owner of Al Kamel General Trading and has 12 years of experience in wholesale. He sells in different countries such as Oman, Jordan, Dubai and Yemen.

Common Questions

Frequently asked questions

Do you sell to the general public?

No. Al Kamel General Trading is a wholesaler serving retail businesses — supermarkets, delis, and convenience stores. If you operate a store, contact us to discuss setting up a trade account.

How do I get prices?

Send us your product list through the inquiry form, or call (442) 444-4443. We will confirm availability and current case pricing for the items you need.

Do you carry specific brands?

Availability varies by line. Tell us the brands or product types you are looking for and we will confirm what we currently carry before you order.

Where are you located, and when are you open?

Our warehouse is at 3539 Lawson Blvd, Oceanside, NY 11572. Business hours are 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM. Call ahead before visiting so we can be ready for you.

How do I place an order?

Start with an inquiry — by phone, email, or the form below. Once pricing and availability are confirmed, we will go over your order with you and arrange fulfillment.
